name: 视口单位转换（vh / vw ↔ px）

map.vw = 视口宽度的 1%，vh = 视口高度的 1%。做全屏首屏、自适应间距时: Convert between viewport units and pixels: vw and vh are 1% of the viewport width and height, handy for full-screen layouts.
map.px → vw：vw = px ÷ 视口宽度 × 100；vw → px：px: px → vw: vw = px ÷ viewport width × 100; vw → px: px = vw × viewport width ÷ 100 (vh is calculated by height the same way)
map.vw 与 vh 分别是视口宽、高的 1%，因此换算需给定基准视口尺寸。按宽度换算: vw and vh are 1% of the viewport width and height respectively, so conversion needs a base viewport size. Width-based uses viewport width, height-based uses viewport height; the reverse (vw/vh → px) is multiplication, for replacing fixed px with adaptive spacing and full-screen layouts.
map.基准视口尺寸（px，宽或高视模式而定）: Base viewport size (px, width or height per mode)
map.vw 永远基于视口【宽度】，vh 永远基于视口【高度】，二者互不相干。: vw is always based on viewport [width], vh always on viewport [height]; they are independent.
map.移动端注意：部分浏览器的 vh 包含地址栏高度，可用 dvh/svh/lvh 等: Mobile note: some browsers' vh includes the address-bar height; use dynamic units like dvh/svh/lvh for more accuracy.
map.100vw 在大屏可能超出预期并引发横向滚动，用于全宽时建议配合 overflo: 100vw on large screens may exceed expectations and trigger horizontal scroll; for full width use overflow-x:hidden.
map.换算公式：vw = px ÷ 视口宽度 × 100；px = vw ÷ 100: Formula: vw = px ÷ viewport width × 100; px = vw ÷ 100 × viewport width (vh uses height the same way).
map.<p><strong>输入：</strong>50vw、视口宽 1280。</p:
Input: 50vw, viewport width 1280.

Process: Multiply.

Output: 640px; changes with viewport.
map.vh 受地址栏影响有波动，关键布局可用 dvh 等新版单位。: vh fluctuates with the address bar; for critical layouts use newer units like dvh.
map.% 相对父元素，vh/vw 相对视口；全屏布局用视口单位更直接。: % is relative to the parent, vh/vw to the viewport; viewport units are more direct for full-screen layouts.
